answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by pricing identity: every address must post a slashable bond and clear a compute ledge before it can act. Voting weight tracks bonded value, not wallet count, so a thousand fakes buy a thousand times the stake and lose it all if any one misbehaves. Diversity rules then demand independent hosting on separate island networks, so one farm cannot multiply. Like a scarce opal, verified reputation cannot be copied, stripping mass-made identities of leverage.
